image_description: A white minibus (resembling a Mercedes-Benz Sprinter) parked on a paved street. The vehicle features a high roof, a row of tinted side windows, standard alloy wheels, and a front grille with a visible logo. The background includes residential buildings and palm trees.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Boxy body shape noticeably shorter than a full-size bus, yet tall enough for passengers to stand or sit upright comfortably.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle exhibits the characteristic high-roof van silhouette, distinct from low-profile cars and significantly shorter than city buses.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large front windshield is clearly visible, along with a continuous row of dark/tinted rectangular windows running along the side.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Height is substantial, with entrance door at front or mid-body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The driver's door is visible at the front. The overall height-to-length ratio is consistent with a standing-height minibus.
While the passenger sliding door is closed, the vertical seam and handle mechanism typical of a sliding door are visible behind the front wheel arch.
The short hood (bonnet) ahead of the windshield indicates a front-engine layout, typical of this class of vehicle.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rear flat or slightly angled panel with taillights and license plate mount.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rear of the vehicle is outside the frame; only the side and front-three-quarters are visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: White, yellow, or company livery paint with route markings.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle is painted white with grey lower cladding, fitting the 'white' or 'company livery' description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Standard van-sized wheels with steel or alloy rims.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Visible wheels are proportionate to the vehicle size, featuring realistic rim structures and tire sidewalls.
The window count and body length visually correspond to a capacity of approximately 8-12 seats, fitting the minibus definition.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The characters on the front license plate are illegible and malformed, appearing as generic AI-generated text artifacts rather than a valid registration number.
The reflections in the side windows are overly uniform and lack specific environmental details, appearing slightly 'painted on' rather than optically reflective.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific make/model consistency (e.g., Mercedes Sprinter features) and rule out hybrid vehicle hallucinations.
To verify the structural rigidity of the bus body and ensure correct spatial separation from the background buildings.
Wheels are common failure points in AI generation; need to check for fusion with the ground or irregular rim geometry.
To rigorously analyze the legibility of the front license plate and any brand badging on the grille.

focus_areas: Wheel rim symmetry and tire-ground contact
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the front license plate; AI often fails to render readable text here. Also, inspect the wheel rims for elliptical distortion which might indicate perspective errors. Verify that the side mirror connects logically to the door frame without melting.
